name: Thexton Manufacturing Co.
old_description: At Thexton, we’ve been working with mechanics like you since 1960.
about:
Thexton Manufacturing Co. has operated from Edina, Minnesota since its founding in 1907. The privately held company, now led by President Ross Tichy and Board Chair Brian Tichy, began as a supplier of automotive specialty tools and has remained focused on that market for over a century.

The company designs and manufactures a range of professional automotive tools, including electrical and battery tools, diagnostic and fuel system testers, terminal tools, cooling system tools, brake tools, and lubrication equipment. Production takes place in a 20,000-square-foot facility that houses a machine shop, an R&D department with CAD capabilities, an electronic design and assembly area, and a complete packaging line. Thexton introduces 10 to 20 new products each year, developed by an in-house engineering team that includes Senior Product Development Engineer Josh Oachs.

Thexton serves the automotive aftermarket, selling through a network of distributors to professional mechanics and technicians. Its catalog targets repair shops and technicians who need specialized tools for hard-to-find repairs.

The company emphasizes continuous innovation, stating that it has kept pace with automotive market changes by launching new products annually. It also operates a royalty program that invites outside inventors to submit tool ideas for potential manufacturing and distribution.

name: Third Coast Apparel
old_description: Third Coast Apparel is the Leading Custom Apron Manufacturer specializing in the highest quality Slot Wallets, Casino Fannypacks, Bingo and Dealer Aprons and custom casino aprons designed for the gaming industry.  All products handmade in the USA.
about:
Third Coast Apparel was founded in 2005 in Carson City, Nevada. The company operates as a custom apron manufacturer focused on the gaming industry, with all products handmade in the United States.

The company produces slot wallets, casino fannypacks, bingo aprons, dealer aprons, and housekeeping aprons. It offers custom design, replication, and resizing of pouches and other products, with hundreds of proven designs available. Embroidery services are offered, and all items are made to order with a typical production lead time of three to four weeks. The minimum order quantity is six pieces.

Third Coast Apparel serves casinos and gaming establishments, providing a complete line of aprons and accessories for slot attendants, dealers, bingo staff, and housekeeping teams. Its products are designed specifically for the gaming environment.

The company emphasizes a one-year manufacturer’s guarantee, competitive pricing for small quantities, and the availability of samples. It positions itself as a one-stop shop for casino aprons, highlighting the ability to design, replicate, or build products to suit specific operational needs.

name: Thomsen Foodservice
old_description: Thomsen Foodservice has been the trusted broadline food distributor for independent restaurants, chefs, and foodservice operators across Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut since 1951. We deliver personalized service and professional-grade ingredients, from dry goods and refrigerated products to produce and frozen foods, to help your kitchen succeed.
about:
Thomsen Foodservice has operated from Rumford, Rhode Island, since 1951. The company began as a broadline food distributor serving independent restaurants, chefs, and foodservice operators across Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut.

The distributor supplies a full range of professional-grade ingredients, including dry goods, refrigerated products, produce, and frozen foods. In addition to delivery service, Thomsen operates Thomsen Marketplace, a cash-and-carry store in East Providence that is open to both foodservice professionals and the public. The marketplace stocks restaurant essentials, commercial kitchen equipment, and one of the region's largest gluten-free selections.

Customers include independent restaurants, caterers, and home cooks throughout the three-state area. The company carries branded lines such as Kettle Cuisine soups, sides, and sauces, and Bindi premium desserts, alongside local Rhode Island favorites. It also provides seasonal product guidance and menu playbooks for occasions such as Lent, Valentine's Day, and major sporting events.

Thomsen emphasizes personalized service and a curated product assortment designed to help kitchen operators succeed. The combination of broadline distribution, a public-facing marketplace, and a focus on local and specialty items distinguishes the business in the New England foodservice market.

name: Three R Plastics Inc
old_description: Founded in 1994, Three R Plastics Inc. has continued to grow and serve a wide range of markets.  Three generations work together here as a family business working for you.  Click below for more info.
about:
Three R Plastics Inc. operates from Spring Grove, Illinois, where it was founded in 1994. Three generations of the founding family work together in the business, which has grown steadily since its start.

The company combines injection molding and mold making under one roof, running a full-service mold manufacturing shop in-house. Nearly all of the molds it builds — about 99 percent — are run in its own molding department. It also accepts transfer molds and provides mold servicing for customers who lack that capability. Its precision injection molding covers parts from smaller than a fingernail up to several pounds, using a wide range of resins including glass- and carbon-filled grades and high-temperature materials such as PEEK and Ultem. Swiss lathes are used for custom production pieces and to supplement molding with overmolded materials.

The company serves a wide range of markets, though specific industries are not detailed in its public materials.

What distinguishes the operation is the integration of mold building and molding in a single facility, allowing tight control from tool design through production. The ability to take on transfer molds and service existing tooling extends that control to projects that originated elsewhere.

name: Tigon Medical
about:
Tigon Medical is based in Millersville, Maryland. The company was founded in 2017 by Jeremy Clark, who set out to deliver innovative suture anchors while addressing the single-use plastic waste generated by many surgical procedures. This sustainability focus became the core of Tigon’s mission.

The company designs and sells surgical implants, instruments, and suture for the sports medicine market. Its product lines include knotted and knotless suture anchors (such as the Manticore, Tomahawk, Javelin, and Dual Infiniti families), suture products (TigoLoop, TigoTape, TigoCable), the Fire System, Flyer, biologics (Vampire Awl, TigoDerm), and dedicated instrument sets for shoulder, foot and ankle, and bicep procedures. Tigon received clearance to market its products in 2019 and has since expanded into labral and rotator cuff surgeries. The team includes engineering, quality and regulatory, and sales personnel.

Tigon serves the sports medicine and orthopedic surgery sectors, with a focus on shoulder procedures — rotator cuff repair, labral repair, instability, and biceps repair — as well as foot and ankle procedures such as Achilles repair and the Brostrom procedure. Its customers are surgeons, hospitals, and surgical centers.

The company says its GreenRepair® initiative sets it apart by minimizing waste across all surgical procedures, while its broader goal is to improve patient outcomes and surgeon performance through innovative implant and instrument design.

name: Timber Woodworking Machinery
old_description: From the Commercial Woodworking Cabinet Shop, to the Custom Furniture Manufacturer, to the Home Shop Hobbyist. We are the “GO-TO-GUYS” for all your woodworking tools, equipment, and supply needs!
about:
Timber Woodworking Machinery, Inc. operates from a 33,000-square-foot facility on three acres in Mesa, Arizona. The company was founded in 1989 by Charles and Paulette Larson after they struggled to find quality tools and supplies for their own woodworking projects. The Larsons opened their first store in a 2,700-square-foot strip mall on East Southern Avenue, and the business grew steadily. In 2005, their daughter RaeAnn Yoder and son-in-law Mel Yoder assumed control of the machinery division, and when the founders retired in 2010, the couple also took over the lumber side of the operation.

The retailer stocks a broad range of woodworking tools, equipment, and supplies, including hardwood lumber, used machinery, used parts, carbide router bits, and sharpening services. Its showroom spans roughly 13,000 square feet and displays products from brands such as Amana, Bosch, CMT, Freud, Delta, Jet, Powermatic, and others. The company also runs a consignment program that allows customers to sell their own used equipment through the store.

Customers include commercial cabinet shops, custom furniture manufacturers, and home-shop hobbyists across the Southwest. The business serves both large production operations and individual woodworkers, offering everything from hand carving tools to large production machines.

They emphasize unrivaled customer satisfaction as the foundation of their business.

name: Timbercraft Custom Dovetail Drawers
old_description: Since 2003, Timbercraft has specialized in serving the needs of Cabinetmakers, Millworkers and Contractors throughout the Northeast — utilizing premium materials to fabricate custom dovetail drawers in a lean manufacturing facility with a 3-5 day turnaround time. Hold a TimberCraft drawer in your hands, and you’ll see and feel why 20 years later, we continue to set the standard for quality workmanship and customer satisfaction.
about:
Timbercraft Custom Dovetail Drawers was founded in 2003 in New Milford, Connecticut. The company began by specializing in custom dovetail drawers for cabinetmakers, millworkers, and contractors throughout the Northeast.

The company operates a lean manufacturing facility that produces custom dovetail drawers with a consistent 3-5 day turnaround. Drawers are made from select or better grades of maple and birch, with 5/8-inch side thickness, 1/16-inch radius top edges, and 3/8-inch Baltic birch bottoms. A 100% solid UV coating provides a hard, uniform, solvent-free finish. Heights range from 2 1/8 inches to 12 1/8 inches for birch and 11 3/8 inches for maple, with edge-glue panel techniques allowing heights up to 22 3/8 inches. Widths and depths run from 3 inches to 58 inches for birch and 43 3/4 inches for maple.

Timbercraft serves cabinetmakers, millworkers, and general contractors across the Northeast, including the Tri-State area where palletized orders ship next business day via LTL. The company does not offer value, budget, or economy grade drawers, emphasizing premium materials and refusing to recover scrap wood for drawer components.

The company highlights its consistent 3-5 day turnaround, unmatched customer service, and premium material selection as key differentiators. Orders are acknowledged by email and, once approved and released into production, cannot be changed. Credit cards are kept on file and charged the day before completion, and all freight charges are prepaid and included in acknowledgments.

about:
Timberline Manufacturing Co. operates from Marion, Iowa, as a 100% employee-owned company specializing in complex electrical sub-assemblies. The business emphasizes its employee-ownership model, though its founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides control panel assembly, wire harness and cable assembly, electronic assembly, electro-mechanical assembly, soldering, and value-added services such as kitting, housing assembly, connector sealing, and D-sub assembly. It also offers engineering analysis, pre-production design review, prototyping, and RF testing for commercial and military applications. The company states it can bring most prototype concepts to reality in less than three weeks.

Timberline serves manufacturers in mining equipment, material handling, road construction equipment, airplane ground support equipment, military communications, agricultural equipment, commercial service equipment, highway service trucks, emergency response vehicles, and utility service vehicles. Its customer base includes defense and aerospace contractors as well as heavy-equipment OEMs.

The company highlights its employee-owned culture, 100-plus years of combined RF testing experience, and Midwest location as key differentiators. It was founded on a commitment to deliver high-quality electrical sub-assemblies on time, with engineering support to optimize designs for cost and performance.

name: Tischler Wood Products, Inc.
old_description: Established in 1994, Tischler Wood takes great pride in crafting custom wood solutions to meet your needs.
about:
Tischler Wood Products, Inc. is based in Avon, Minnesota, and was founded in 1994 by Bryan Tischler, who serves as president and CEO. The company began as a small operation and has grown steadily, now training the next generation of woodworkers while maintaining a team that includes long-tenured craftsmen such as Chuck, who rejoined after decades in the trade.

The shop produces custom cabinetry and millwork for virtually every room in a home: kitchens and islands, bathrooms, living rooms, mudrooms and laundry rooms, garages, home entertainment centers, offices and bedrooms. In-house capabilities cover design, estimating, project coordination, shop drawings, and installation, all managed by a dedicated project coordination team.

The company serves residential homeowners, general contractors, and interior designers throughout the Minneapolis area. Testimonials highlight projects ranging from a first-time homeowner's kitchen remodel to a large custom home featuring painted white, bleached hickory, and stained alder cabinetry, along with rustic mantels and vaulted ceiling beams.

Tischler Wood emphasizes that quality never goes out of style, positioning unparalleled customer service and the highest quality cabinetry as its core differentiators. The firm also cites its commitment to a positive workplace and passing on work ethic and dedication to craft as reasons it was started and why it continues to operate.

name: Todd’s Warehouse
old_description: Security and safety in food manufacturing has become so much more of a concern for large commercial manufacturers and Todd’s fills a demand that guarantees the safety and accuracy of the ingredients weighed to exact batch sizes each and every time. SQF Certification ensures that we maintain food safety and quality for your brand.
about:
Todd's Warehouse (operating as Todd's Foods) traces its roots to 1926 when Martin Todd and his wife Arlene began selling seasoning blends to meat lockers and markets in Des Moines, Iowa. The company expanded across the Midwest through a network of sales routes. In June 2011, Andy Holt acquired Todd's LTD, and in October 2015 the business purchased the Summit Foods factory in Madison, Nebraska, adding liquid blending and packaging capacity. Today the company operates dry production facilities in Des Moines at the intersection of I-80 and I-235 and a liquid production plant in Madison, NE, positioning it for national distribution.

The company provides contract food manufacturing (co-packing), dry bulk blending, dry packaging, and liquid packaging services. Its liquid lines handle hot-fill products such as BBQ sauces, salsas, salad dressings, and vinegars in containers ranging from 10-ounce jars to large totes, and employ ozone sanitation for bottles and headspace. Dry capabilities include flexible stand-up pouches and various bulk, restaurant, and retail pack formats. A HACCP program and SQF certification govern food safety, while a Process Authority oversees acidified food processes. The firm also offers formulation development for kosher, organic, non-irradiated, GMO-free, and gluten-free requirements.

Customers include large commercial food manufacturers, restaurant chains, grocery delis, foodservice operators, retail brands, hospitals, and institutional buyers. Todd's has helped entrepreneurs turn home recipes into commercial products sold on retail, hospital, restaurant, and institutional shelves. The company emphasizes customized production for medium to large orders and serves both established companies and start-ups.

Todd's differentiates itself through its SQF certification, ozone sanitation, hot-fill and acidified process capabilities, and strategic Midwest locations that enable cost-effective shipping nationwide. The business highlights its 90-plus years of experience in seasonings and spices, award-winning products, and a focus on being a reliable partner for food packaging needs.
